The Frontier

From desert outpost to a meadow of machines

Start with a training saber in a dusty trading post. By the end you’ll have crossed a lake by hoverbike, raided an underground lab, teleported to orbit, conquered an ice colosseum and stepped onto a meadow where machines fly.

Outpost Kessa

Lv 1–10

A wind-scoured trading post on the edge of the Dunes, with a crashed shuttle under its canopy. Your first saber, your first hack, your first Scrap Bot.

Dunewell Town

Lv 1–16

Forge, tavern, cape merchant and a bike dealer who only sells to riders the Elder trusts.

Neo-Haven

Lv 16–38

A chrome city of glass towers across Lake Vire. Grand hotel, linked bank, and a mayor with secrets.

Neon Sprawl

Lv 25–44

Rain-soaked back streets where Robo-Hounds patrol and Corp Datavaults pay out to good hackers.

Sublevel 9 Lab

Lv 25–55

A sealed research lab under the Sprawl, guarded by the six-armed Infiltrator Guardian.

Orbital Hub Aster

Safe zone

A station in orbit with a glass floor over open space, a casino, a forge and teleporters to everywhere.

Mirehold

Lv 27–36

A stilt village of gas-masked swamp folk, a candlelit chapel and a taxidermist who mounts everything you defeat.

The Foundry

Lv 38–54

Molten vats, roaming Reaper Endoskeletons and the Forgemaster Colossus at the far end.

Frostpeak Outpost

Lv 47–49

A snowbound camp behind the hub’s sealed vault. Frostfang Yetis and Cryo Sentinels roam the drifts.

Frostpeak Summit

Safe zone

A wind-blasted ledge under the aurora, with bauble-hung trees, rare Aurorite and the Eskimo Elder who guards the ice Colosseum.

Frostpeak Colosseum

Lv 47–49

An arena carved from glacier ice, packed with cheering spectators. The Eskimo Elder spins in on a snow tornado to summon five waves of Yetis and Cryo Sentinels, then the Glacier Warden itself.

Verdant Expanse

Safe zone

A lush, impossible meadow reached through the Derelict Lab, where machines drift through the sky and the Sage waits at journey’s end.

Skills

Eight skills. Every one goes to 99.

Progress the classic way: every swing, hack and ore you mine earns experience. Pick a path or master them all, then wear the skillcape to prove it.

  • Start with a pickaxe, turn it into a drill, then upgrade through seven tiers all the way to a Mining Laser.
  • Bury bones from every creature to deepen your Focus, then spend it on attack and defence rituals.
  • Craft full sets of melee and ranged armour at the workbench.
  • Earn a cape with its own emblem for every skill you max.
  • Melee1/99Laser sabers, axes, flails and chainsaws.
  • Ranged1/99Pistols, rifles and bazookas, with real line of sight.
  • Hacking1/99Crack kiosks, mainframes and datavaults for credits.
  • Mining1/99Start with a pickaxe, then build drills for seven ores from Ferrite to Aurorite, ending with a Mining Laser.
  • Gathering1/99Healing Pods, Blissnuts, Glowcaps and festive Bauble Berries.
  • Crafting1/99Smelt bars and forge full armour sets at the workbench.
  • Questing1/99Eighteen quests, from bar brawls to a main story that ends with a party hat.
  • Focus1/99Bury bones, pray at altars, channel combat rituals.
Focus

Bury bones. Bend reality.

Every creature drops bones. Bury them to train Focus, then spend focus points (refilled at any altar) on four kinds of power.

  • ✦
    RitualsCombat buffs you switch on and off. Attack rituals sharpen your accuracy and damage, defence rituals cut how often and how hard you get hit. They drain focus while they run.
  • ✨
    TransmutationFuse two healing items into one stronger one, from humble Healing Pods all the way up to Bauble Berries.
  • ⇶
    Ability powersKinetic Push blasts nearby enemies into the walls, and Mind Freeze locks them in place so they can’t move or strike.
  • ☠
    Ability summonsCall a ghostly ally to fight beside you for 15 seconds: a Skeleton, a golden Knight, a Cyborg Samurai and, for true masters, the Warlock Master with fire, ice and thunder.
The Armoury

Gear that shows up on your character

Everything you equip is drawn on your hero, from bronze plate to a six-piece insect carapace. Mix melee sets, ranged sets and rare hybrid armour to build your own look.

Legendary weapons

Rare drops, secrets, casino jackpots and gold-dyed upgrades. Each one has its own look and effects. 37 weapons in all, from training sabers to plasma pistols that fire glowing goo.

  • ★ Devil Edge
  • ★ Dart of Destruction
  • ★ Twin Reaver Chainsaws
  • ★ Twin Deluxe Chainsaws
  • ★ Gold Reaper Scythe
  • ★ Skyfall Beacon
  • ★ Light Bringer
  • ★ Stormcaller Bolt
  • ★ Cryo Talons
  • ★ Barbed Yo-Yo

Ten armour sets

Five melee sets from Bronze Guard to Abyssal, five ranged sets from Shadow Outlaw to Blaze Vanguard, each crafted from the ore you mine.

Boss-only hybrid armour

Warhunter, Shadowveil and Hivemind sets drop only from bosses, at 1 in 20. They boost melee and ranged at once.

Master capes

Max a skill, wear the proof

Reach level 99 in any skill and the Cape Merchant in Dunewell will sell you its master cape. Every one of the eight capes has its own colours and an emblem on the back: crossed sabers for Melee, a crosshair for Ranged, glowing circuitry for Hacking, a pickaxe for Mining and more.

Capes show on your hero from every angle, flowing behind you as you walk.

The main quest

Five chapters, five showdowns

  1. Main QuestSting in the Deep

    Slay the King Scorpion in the depths of Dunewell Mine and earn the right to ride a hoverbike.

  2. Main QuestRetake the Lab

    Hack the laser fence in the Neon Sprawl and take down the Infiltrator Guardian.

  3. Main QuestEmerald of the Mire

    Help the Bog Warden of Mirehold and claim the gem that opens the hub’s vault.

  4. Main QuestBigger They Are…

    Fight through the Foundry and topple the Forgemaster Colossus.

  5. Main QuestChallenger Approaches

    Earn the Eskimo Elder’s blessing, survive five waves of the Frostpeak Colosseum and fell the Glacier Warden.

  6. Main QuestWe Came, We Saw

    Follow the Colosseum key into the Derelict Lab, beat Zomborg Prime and find the Sage on the Verdant Expanse.

Between the battles

Plenty to do off the main path

Aster Casino

Play 21 against Dealer Vex or bet on roulette. Hit a single number and win a legendary.

Mortimer’s bestiary

Every creature you defeat gets mounted in the Mirehold taxidermy. Fill twelve pedestals for a Plasma Pistol, and all of them for a vial of Gold Dye.

Bar brawls & heists

Fist-fight Brakk the Brute, find a stolen hotel keycard and expose a corrupt mayor.

Gold Dye

Gild a Buster Axe into the Gold Reaper Scythe, Twin Reaver Chainsaws into Twin Deluxe Chainsaws, or a Skyfall Beacon into the Light Bringer, which calls down pillars of light. Find dye in a locked strongbox, earn it from Mortimer, or pay Vanta a fortune.

Hidden caches

Secrets are tucked into every corner, from a well in Dunewell Mine to a sealed cache in Grimfen Swamp that hides the Toxic Claws.

Traders

Sell crafted gear, and any weapon a merchant stocks, to the Wanderer, the Neo-Haven armory or the hub’s weapons counter when your pack gets full.

Achievements

28 milestones to chase, from First Blood and Boss Rush to Millionaire and Treasure Hunter, each with its own trophy toast.

Cracker party hats

Finish the story and pull a cracker with the Sage for a paper party hat in red, blue, green or yellow. Swap colours any time.

Linked banks

Store gear in Neo-Haven, the hub or Mirehold and collect it from any of them.

A chapel quiz

Answer Mother Silt’s four questions to earn the Focus Band and its night-vision goggles.

Original soundtrack

Twelve original 8-bit themes, from a jungle-drum main menu and a jazz-fusion lab groove to an icy arena battle and a mystic summit hymn, plus sound effects for every weapon. All generated in the browser.

Play anywhere

Built for the desk and the bus

EverSaber runs in any modern browser. Open the link, pick a name and you’re playing in seconds.

On PC

  • Click to walk, fight and interact
  • Side panel for skills, gear and quests
  • World map and illustrated atlas

On phone

  • Full-screen view, portrait or landscape
  • Quick buttons for healing and focus
  • Tap to act, long-press to inspect

Your progress saves in your browser. Export a save file to carry it between devices.
